newsitem.title: USA: Wackenhut sees 1997 revs over $1 billion.
newsitem.headline: Wackenhut sees 1997 revs over $1 billion.

text.p: Wackenhut Corp said it expects 1997 full year revenues to exceed $1 billion, after earlier reporting $906.1 million in revenues for its 1996 year.

"This year we expect Wackenhut's revenues to exceed $1 billion," noted George Wackenhut, chairman and chief executive. "Our consistent revenue growth is based on the success of our diversification efforts as we find new opportunities to take advantage of our human resources management expertise."
Wackenhut Corp reported higher fourth quarter and year-end net income and sales, earlier Wednesday.

"Our dramatic gain in earnings last year resulted primarily from growth in our North American Operations Group and Wackenhut Corrections subsidiary and improvements in our capital structure," said company president Richard Wackenhut.
"I'm confident that the growth will continue, and our goal is to increase net income by more than 20 percent in 1997," Richard Wackenhut said.
